name: PyTypeInfer Engine
target_user: Language runtime engineers, static analysis researchers, and Python tool developers
problem: Dynamically-typed Python codebases suffer from latent type errors, while mainstream type checkers are monolithic, heavy external tools that hide their internal unification and abstract interpretation algorithms.
pain: Developers building embedded script engines or code analysis tools cannot easily embed light, zero-dependency static type inference engines or inspect control-flow-dependent type narrowing step-by-step.
solution: A zero-dependency static type inference and abstract interpretation engine written in Python 3.12 standard library. It parses Python ASTs, constructs control-flow graphs (CFGs), performs unification-based Hindley-Milner type inference, and tracks abstract domain value ranges without executing the code.
verification: A deterministic test suite validating type inference against malformed ASTs, deeply nested control-flow branches, recursive function type definitions, cyclic import dependency graphs, and contradictory variable assignments.
major_features: Control-Flow Graph (CFG) builder extracting basic blocks, edge predicates, and jump targets from standard ASTs
Unification-based Hindley-Milner type inference algorithm resolving variable types and function signatures
Flow-sensitive type narrowing engine evaluating isinstance checks, None assertions, and early return guards
Abstract domain interval analyzer tracking numeric integer bounds and string literal set constraints across basic blocks
Parametric polymorphism and generic type variable solver resolving bounded constraints
Structural subtyping checker validating Protocol compliance and duck-typing interfaces
Dead-code path detector flagging unreachable CFG blocks and unreachable conditional branches
Deterministic error reporting formatter emitting structural line-and-column diagnostic JSON reports
truth_policy: Only validated behavior may be claimed as working.
